item.title: Version 1.0.2
item.description:
What’s new

  • Light / Dark / System appearance (Settings → App → Appearance); thumbnails and pinned screenshots follow the theme
  • Image and video editors: fixed full-width toolbars, the picture always fits between them, Reset Zoom, a full menu bar
  • New Polyline tool (N); Pencil with ⇧ draws straight lines; ⇧-drag moves annotations straight; arrow keys nudge
  • Smooth Blur, rounded shapes with a corner radius for Blur, Pixelate and Spotlight
  • Cleaner color pickers and buttons; new Highlighter icon; new layered app icon on macOS 26
  • Accessibility: VoiceOver labels, keyboard focus, better contrast, Interface Size (Settings → App)
  • Fixes: camera bubble no longer records as a black box; Delete moves to Trash with ⌘Z to undo

item.title: Version 1.0.1
item.description:
What’s new

  • Automatic updates: OneFrame checks for new versions once a day and installs them in a click
  • Check for Updates… in the menu bar menu and in Settings → App → About
  • Settings → App → Updates: turn automatic checks on or off, or let OneFrame download and install updates by itself
